# Copilot instructions

The conventions for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root.
Read that file before writing any code.

This file exists only as a pointer: some tooling looks for
`.github/copilot-instructions.md` specifically, and `AGENTS.md` is the single source of
truth. Do not add rules here — they would drift from `AGENTS.md` the first time one of
them changed.
